title: Clarify user_exists API endpoint naming
description: The sieve_admin.rs API accepts a {username} path parameter (e.g., GET /admin/sieve/{username}) but only ever accepts '_global'. The function user_exists() (lines 333-339) validates this and rejects all other usernames with 404. However, there's no explanation for why the API surface looks like it supports multiple users when it doesn't. Add a comment explaining that the path parameter name is a legacy artifact or clarify whether per-user Sieve management is intentionally deferred to a future version.
